entities.summary: Paulo Jr. (b. 1969-04-30, Belo Horizonte) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Belo Horizonte and Brazil. Known in the fields of brazil, composers & musicians, americas.
